result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred limits for CGL, E&O, cyber, workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. Requiring cyber coverage is appropriate given the stated processing of Licensee trading data. It preserves the representation-by-counsel provision and is generally well drafted. However, requiring all coverages for one year after expiration or termination goes beyond the playbook and is not narrowly tailored, particularly for CGL and workers’ compensation.
